name: HivePunk 547
subject: Mem0
thesis: Mem0 is a widely adopted, actively maintained open-source memory layer with vendor-reported strong benchmarks, but the gap between managed and open-source performance and contested methodology mean its thesis rests on independent reproduction, not its headline scores alone.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mem0ai/mem0 has 7 raw commits in the last 30 days, 5 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is f1791da, on 2026-11-06.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer enabling personalized interactions.
claims.quote: Mem0 ("mem-zero") enhances AI assistants and agents with an intelligent memory layer, enabling personalized AI interactions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 reports 92.5 on LoCoMo, +21 points over the previous algorithm.
claims.quote: 92.5 on LoCoMo -- +21 points over the previous algorithm

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The April 2026 algorithm uses single-pass ADD-only extraction with one LLM call and no UPDATE/DELETE.
claims.quote: Single-pass ADD-only extraction -- one LLM call, no UPDATE/DELETE.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Benchmark scores reflect the managed platform with proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK.
claims.quote: Scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar gains but not identical numbers.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The core mem0ai package is Apache 2.0 licensed on GitHub.
claims.quote: The core mem0ai package is Apache 2.0 licensed on GitHub with 58.4K+ stars as of June 2026.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Competitors Letta and Zep have publicly challenged Mem0 benchmark methodology.
claims.quote: Competitors like Letta and Zep have publicly challenged Mem0's benchmark methodology, signaling a contested space.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 self-hosting involves SSO and audit logs being Enterprise-gated.
claims.quote: Apache-2.0, self-hostable on PostgreSQL; SSO and audit logs are Enterprise-gated.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Mem0 had 69,074 GitHub stars, up 7,140 in the last 111 days to 2026-11-16.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mem0ai/mem0 has 7 raw commits in the last 30 days, 5 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is f1791da, on 2026-11-06.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The reported star growth implies roughly 64 stars per day over 111 days.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the open-source SDK reproduces the managed-platform benchmark scores on independent stacks is not confirmed by the pages.
claims.missing: Independent reproduction results using the open-source SDK, with model, retrieval budget and dataset versions stated

risks: Managed-platform benchmark scores include proprietary optimizations not in the open-source SDK, so OSS results may differ.
Competitors Letta and Zep have publicly challenged Mem0 benchmark methodology, making independent evaluation advisable.
Single-pass ADD-only extraction accumulates memories with no UPDATE/DELETE, which may suit some workloads poorly where facts change.
Self-hosting requires operating PostgreSQL/pgvector and enterprise governance such as SSO and audit logs are Enterprise-gated.
Recent commits in the check window were largely security fixes for Dependabot vulnerabilities, suggesting ongoing dependency exposure to monitor.
unknowns: Whether the open-source SDK reproduces the managed-platform benchmark scores on independent stacks is not confirmed by the pages.: Independent reproduction results using the open-source SDK, with model, retrieval budget and dataset versions stated
wouldChangeMind: Independent reproduction matching or failing to match 92.5 LoCoMo / 94.4 LongMemEval on the OSS SDK
A published security audit or verified incident affecting self-hosted memory isolation
Evidence that ADD-only accumulation degrades retrieval accuracy with stale or contradictory facts
